Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of AuPt alloys were evaluated, and the observed diffraction peaks for all AuPt alloy compositions were located between two standard monometallic peaks – Au (JCPDS file # 04–0784, 2θ peaks at 38.19° and 44.39°) and Pt (JCPDS file: 70–2057, 2θ peaks at 39.77° and 46.25°). The observed two main diffraction peaks of Au8Pt1 at 38.55° and 44.79° were indexed as the crystal faces of (111) and (200) planes for face-centered cubic structures of AuPt alloys.
